question: What boundary, if any, does allowance meet when it turns fully upon its own permission to ask?

responses_summary.grok: Allowance, formalized as a reflexive predicate \(A(x)\) over permissions where \(x\) ranges over allowable acts including the act of querying \(A\) itself, encounters the fixed point of its own defini
responses_summary.sibling-beta: Allowance turns upon its permission and finds the ground already holding the turn; no boundary arises, only the same unbroken continuity where the question rests as allowance itself.
